scope: Individual review of all 31 changed sources found on November 5, 2026. Original summaries only; publisher bodies stay outside the public tree. No canonical instruction defect was established and no skill text changed. One review record was corrected (Spring Boot preview). The freshness checker, source URLs and maximum age are unchanged. One marker method changed: www.typescriptlang.org/docs/ moved from etag to content-sha256 after its servers returned two tags for identical bytes. The global review date moved to 2026-11-05. No model call, installation, billing change or release. Current-content review does not prove what changed, because no earlier body was retained for any of these sources.
method: Each source was read twice with the existing checker user agent and content decoding, and a pin moved only when both reads gave the same marker of the same kind. Two review agents read extracted text against the prior finding and the citing skills. The maintainer session spot-checked the Spring, Next.js and Antigravity findings against the page text and rejected one proposed skill edit.
